_comment: run_28a = run_25 with settlement.weight = fitness: within each block birds spread until realized lambda (model's own Beverton-Holt fecundity, Allee excluded) is equal across occupied cells; cells worse than that even when empty receive none. Nests capacity weighting when vital rates are equal within a block; no new parameters.

Why: E008's K-weighted settlement flattened vital rates (fundamental lambda > 1 in 99% of cells) and moved all spatial structure into K -- K decided both how many birds fit AND where they settle (research/age_model E014).
